primitives.name: GLOBAL
primitives.current_hosted_operation: Ordered helper-map, module namespace and builtins lookup, then NameError construction.
primitives.possible_HIA_owner: HIA can own lookup order and miss/error selection; map containment/getitem, exact attribute effect and exception construction remain explicit leaves.
primitives.critical_semantics: No eager name cache; preserve live namespace mutation and distinguish AttributeError from errors raised by mapping operations.

primitives.name: ATTR
primitives.possible_HIA_owner: A complete object lookup owner needs MRO, data/non-data descriptors, instance storage and __getattr__ fallback; isolated exact-object layouts may come first.
primitives.critical_semantics: Descriptors and metaclass hooks, bound method identity, exception timing and mutation prevent treating this as a scalar read.

primitives.name: SET_ATTR
primitives.possible_HIA_owner: Object-runtime owner can choose descriptor versus instance storage and mutation order; actual foreign descriptor calls stay explicit.
primitives.critical_semantics: __setattr__, descriptors, deletion/replacement finalizers and read-only errors.

primitives.name: ITEM
primitives.possible_HIA_owner: HIA container/text owners must handle index conversion, bounds, slices, dictionary lookup and result identity.
primitives.critical_semantics: Exact container type does not remove key/index/equality hooks; dict and sequence subclass dispatch differ.

primitives.name: SET_ITEM
primitives.possible_HIA_owner: HIA container owner chooses indexed mutation/resize/hash collision and replacement sequence.
primitives.critical_semantics: __setitem__, __index__, hash/equality, mutation during lookup and overwritten-object release.

primitives.name: CALL
primitives.current_hosted_operation: Dynamic target(*positional, optional keyword/mapping), up to four direct positional arguments.
primitives.possible_HIA_owner: Keep a documented foreign call transport; migrate named callees only through separately admitted complete owners.
primitives.critical_semantics: Binding error order, **mapping protocol, descriptors, arbitrary callable effects and reentrancy cannot be replaced by a generic native label.

primitives.name: PACK
primitives.current_hosted_operation: Build list/tuple/set/dict from HIA-selected handle vector.
primitives.possible_HIA_owner: HIA can own construction loops and pair/insertion decisions; a collection allocator/ownership layer is required for full replacement.
primitives.critical_semantics: Set/dict hashing and equality, duplicate keys, insertion order, allocation failure and partial cleanup.

primitives.name: ITER
primitives.possible_HIA_owner: A full iterator-acquisition owner needs type-slot/legacy sequence dispatch; raw foreign iterator acquisition can remain a named observation for other owners.
primitives.critical_semantics: __iter__ call/result validation, sequence fallback and exact error semantics.

primitives.name: NEXT
primitives.current_hosted_operation: next(iterator), with StopIteration converted to exhaustion flag.
primitives.possible_HIA_owner: HIA can own exhaustion/error continuation once a primitive yields value/exhaustion/error without changing handled exception state.
primitives.critical_semantics: StopIteration subclasses, PEP479 generator behavior, arbitrary next callbacks and lifetime of exception/value objects.

primitives.name: TRUTH
primitives.possible_HIA_owner: HIA truth owner needs live exact-type observations, length/number facts, and explicit foreign truth/length effects.
primitives.critical_semantics: No assumption that mutable handle slots1/2/3 retain None/False/True; __bool__/__len__ ordering and invalid returns must be preserved.

primitives.name: BINARY
primitives.current_hosted_operation: 24 ordinary/in-place operator choices; current policy uses8 suboperations.
primitives.possible_HIA_owner: A signed arbitrary-precision numeric owner can implement integer operations; a broader operation owner also needs sequence/text and reflected/in-place dispatch.
primitives.critical_semantics: Overflow/zero/shift errors, bool/int distinction, NotImplemented/subtype priority, float/complex behavior, object identity and foreign operators.

primitives.name: UNARY
primitives.possible_HIA_owner: A signed scalar runtime can own complete unary operation decisions, with explicit foreign slot invocation.
primitives.critical_semantics: Arbitrary precision, bool conversion, numeric subclasses, NotImplemented/error text and float signed-zero/NaN.

primitives.name: COMPARE
primitives.possible_HIA_owner: HIA scalar/container comparison owners need type-specific result construction and explicit foreign comparisons/membership.
primitives.critical_semantics: __ne__ is independent of not __eq__; rich comparison may return an opaque object; membership returns bool and can iterate/hash/compare.

primitives.name: UNPACK
primitives.current_hosted_operation: CPython fixed assignment unpack of1..4 targets; current policy20 sites.
primitives.possible_HIA_owner: Recommended next complete bounded control owner: acquisition, n+1 fetches, cardinality decisions, diagnostic choice, ordered cleanup and result publication in HIA.
primitives.critical_semantics: Requires raw slot/type facts, faithful pending-error and temporary-reference handling, and explicit3.12/3.14 diagnostic profiles.

primitives.name: SLICE
primitives.current_hosted_operation: Allocate slice(low, high, step); no index normalization here.
primitives.possible_HIA_owner: HIA can own a slice value representation after handle/value storage exists; exporting a real Python slice still requires allocation.
primitives.critical_semantics: Do not invoke __index__ or normalize at construction, since the current slice constructor stores arbitrary component objects.

primitives.name: APPEND
primitives.current_hosted_operation: list.append(object, item), deliberately bypassing overridden .append lookup.
primitives.possible_HIA_owner: HIA-owned list storage/mutation can eventually replace it; otherwise retain the exact base-list append observation.
primitives.critical_semantics: Accepts list subclasses, bypasses their append override; allocation and old storage lifetime remain observable.

primitives.name: IMPORT
primitives.current_hosted_operation: Three actual relative imports: VALUE_REGISTERS, code_options, emit_wrapper.
primitives.possible_HIA_owner: Keep module import as an explicit external effect; HIA selects the import and its original point.
primitives.critical_semantics: Import hooks, sys.modules identity, circular import state and side effects are Python runtime semantics.

primitives.name: RAISE
primitives.possible_HIA_owner: HIA can decide rejection/error construction; the Python boundary still needs faithful final exception raising.
primitives.critical_semantics: Exception class instantiation, active handled context, cause/context cycles and traceback behavior cannot be replaced by returning a code.

primitives.name: GENERATOR
primitives.current_hosted_operation: Create a real Python generator whose body decisions and yields are HIA-controlled.
primitives.possible_HIA_owner: Retain suspension/throw/close transport as an explicit runtime seam until a generator/object runtime exists.
primitives.critical_semantics: Lazy outer iterator evaluation, send/throw/close, GeneratorExit, PEP479 and generator-frame lifetime.
